title: Complete Web Development Bootcamp
motivation_word: Building the web means building the future. Let's write code that matters!
description: Learn full-stack web development from scratch, mastering everything from basic tags to complex architectures.

title: Advanced CSS & Responsive Layouts
motivation_word: Don't let elements push you around. Take absolute control of your layout and build flawlessly responsive designs.
description: Master Flexbox, Grid, and fixed positioning to create pixel-perfect, responsive websites.

title: Cinematic Image Manipulation & Retouching
motivation_word: Turn ordinary shots into cinematic masterpieces. Your vision is your only limit.
description: Learn professional photo editing, including complex head swaps, color grading for urban nighttime aesthetics, and lighting adjustments.

title: Data Science with Python
motivation_word: Data holds the secrets of the universe; Python is the key to unlock them.
description: Dive into data analysis, visualization, and basic machine learning algorithms using Python.

title: Digital Marketing Masterclass
motivation_word: Don't just reach an audience, build a community that believes in your message.
description: Grow your business online using SEO, social media strategies, and email campaigns.

title: Mobile App Development with Flutter
motivation_word: Bring your biggest ideas to life, one screen at a time.
description: Build beautiful, natively compiled applications for mobile, web, and desktop from a single codebase.

title: UI/UX Design Principles
motivation_word: Design isn't just how it looks, it's how it works and feels for the user.
description: Learn the fundamentals of user experience and interface design using industry-standard tools like Figma.

title: Cloud Computing on AWS
motivation_word: The sky is not the limit; the cloud is where we begin to scale.
description: Prepare for the AWS Solutions Architect exam by mastering cloud infrastructure and deployment.

title: Cyber Security Fundamentals
motivation_word: Defense is the best offense in the modern digital age. Learn to protect what matters.
description: Understand the basics of network security, ethical hacking, and how to defend against modern cyber threats.
